tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink dependence and short-horizon positive gain, while the new long-horizon observations reverse sign. Fit the archived five-parameter sink-coupled adaptation law to all eight observations and submit it for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The long-horizon measurements directly reveal reversal and provide eight observations; the archived dual-horizon mechanism is a more direct explanation, so an additional batch is not yet justified.

considered_alternatives.option: static sink siphon or dual-horizon model without sink inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The former cannot explain horizon-dependent reversal; the latter omits the observed sink-gradient dependence.
